Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Repair of Existing Server Including Supply, Installation, RAID Configuration, OS Installation, Commissioning, Testing and Warranty as per Annexure-I The Board of Radiation and Isotope Technology (BRIT), Vashi Complex, maintains a critical IT infrastructure housed within its data centre to support daily operational workflows. As part of ongoing system upkeep an d infrastructure reliability enhancement, three (3) existing enterprise servers currently deployed in the BRI T Data centre require urgent comprehensive repair, hardware overhaul, and restoration to fully functional, production-ready status. Following thorough technical checks and diagnostic evaluations conducted by the internal IT team, hardwa re faults involving storage degradation and other component failures have been identified across these thr ee servers. To bring them back to their original performance standards, the exact replacement component s and OEM-certified spares detailed in the schedule below must be procured and installed. Furthermore, the scope of work is not strictly limited to component replacement: any additional troublesho oting, minor hardware adjustments, or essential corrective actions discovered or required during the repair and integration process to ensure the complete, stable, and error-free operation of the servers shall be co mprehensively handled by the selected supplier/bidder as part of this contract. Repairing and restoration of the existing servers to fully operational condition by repl acing the failed items including storage drives, configuring RAID, reinstalling the Ope rating System such as Linux, Windows as per requirement and restoring all necessar y server functionalities, and ensuring stable operation through comprehensive install ation and testing. The bidder shall provide all manpower, tools, consumables, software utilities, and tec hnical expertise required for complete execution of the work.

The Service Provider must supply, deliver, and install the following items as part of the repair scope: Standard Make/ Bran Quantity R S.No. Item Description Part Number warranty r d equired equired 1 1 TB SSD Lenovo 4XB7A17126 08 Nos. 1 year 2 300GB HDD Lenovo AL15SEB030N 03 Nos. 1 year 3 300GB HDD IBM 42D0638 04 Nos. 1 year 4 1TB Internal SATA SSD Samsung N/A 02 Nos. 1 year 5 2TB External SSD Samsung N/A 02 Nos. 3years 6 64GB Pen Drive HP N/A 02 Nos. 3years Note:- 1. All supplied spares must be genuine, brand new, and compatible with the existing server infrastructure. R efurbished or incompatible drives will be rejected. 2. Test reports and warranty certificates for all standard items shall be submitted to BRIT on th e respective vendor’s/company’s official letterhead. 3. Warranty of one year trouble free operation after successful commissioning of the system. I. Installation and replacement of the HDDs, including all necessary accessories, connectors, mounting har dware, and consumables required for successful installation. II. Configuration of the RAID controller and RAID array (as per the existing configuration or as directed by th e purchaser), including RAID initialization, verification, and rebuild (if required). III. Installation/Reinstallation of the Operating System (OS), along with installation of all necessary device dri vers, RAID drivers, firmware, patches, and system updates required for proper server operation. IV. Configuration of server BIOS, storage, boot sequence, network settings, and verification of complete hard ware functionality. V. Comprehensive testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning of the server to ensure that it is fully operat ional and free from hardware or RAID-related errors. VI. Submission of an installation and commissioning report, including details of the supplied spare parts (Seri al Numbers), RAID configuration, and successful completion of testing. VII. The bidder shall provide all necessary manpower, tools, software utilities, transportation, and technical su pport required for completion of the work. No additional payment shall be made for installation, configurati on, testing, commissioning, or any incidental activities necessary to make the server fully functional. VIII. The repaired server shall be handed over in a fully operational condition, ready for production use. .
